messages:
marta gomez: hi team — Marta here, first day! trying to open Figma but SSO says 'access denied'. anyone on design who can add me or point me to request flow? also trying to find the product roadmap doc and the research playback folder. Thanks!

lee chen: welcome Marta! :tada: I can add you. what's your company email? Also roadmap is in Notion under Product > Roadmap — I'll paste the link once I'm at my desk.

samir: fyi if SSO shows access denied, try clearing cookies or opening an incognito window. for Okta group provisioning we sometimes need admin to reprovision. if you're blocked, reply with your email and I'll ping the idp team.

marta gomez: marta.gomez@redwood.com — tried incognito, same. thanks Lee/Samir

infra-bot: Created ticket #INC-4572 for idp provisioning. assignee: samir. ETA ~4h. https://infra.redwood/internal/tickets/INC-4572

lee chen: added you to the 'Design - Full' Figma team. you should get an invite in a few mins — let me know if you still can't open files. research playbacks are in Drive > Research > Playbacks; @kate r. runs the weekly synthesis and has the templates.

kate r.: hey Marta, welcome! I'll share the research folder and a quick starter template. for playback summaries we use the file: playbacks/templates/summary.md — will DM it to you. also happy to do a quick intro to our participants list. :wave:

marta gomez: Got the invite, can open files now, thanks all. quick q — where's the canonical PRD template? should I copy from last quarter or is there a new one?

lee chen: use PRD v3 in Notion: https://notion.redwood/product/PRD-v3. short checklist: goals, success metrics, user journeys, open questions. if you want, we can pair tomorrow 10:00am to go through the template.

samir: if you want to see idp logs for your email, run:
```
kubectl logs -n idp idp-proxy-0 | grep marta.gomez@redwood.com
```

marta gomez: pairing sounds great. 10:00am works for me, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
